knowledge_base: Blocker findings should block merge; major findings should block merge unless explicitly waived in the PR description.
Security category covers: deserialization of untrusted input, SQL/command/template injection, secrets in code, and weak crypto.
Correctness category covers: off-by-one errors, returning wrong type, mutable default arguments, and missing await on coroutines.
Performance category covers: O(n^2) hot loops, recompiled regex inside a loop, and N+1 query patterns over ORMs.
Style category should defer to ruff for autofixable rules; reviewers only call out style when ruff is silenced.
Tests category covers: assert-without-message, time.sleep instead of synchronisation, and tests that mutate global state.
Reviewers should look for missing CHANGELOG entries when the diff changes a public API in src/sdk/ or src/cli/.
Diff hunks of more than 400 lines reduce review quality sharply; suggest splitting into a stacked PR series.
Findings should reference a rule_id when possible (e.g. ruff E501, bandit B301) so the author can suppress with confidence.
When the diff deletes tests without adding replacements, flag as a major finding even if unrelated to the goal.

templates.split_pr: Diff is {n_lines} lines; consider splitting into smaller PRs (>{threshold}).
templates.missing_changelog: Public-API path {path} changed but CHANGELOG was not updated.
